classification.difficultyReason: Read one marked point from a hyperbola graph, substitute into y=k/x and solve a one-step equation for k. This is the same demand as p19-q4 part a.

content.prompt: This hyperbola has an equation in the form $y=\frac{k}{x}$. Determine the value of $k$ by substituting in a coordinate and hence find the equation of the hyperbola.
